description: This file contains a shell script with embedded Node.js code that manages changelog entries for pull requests, including validation and updating the CHANGELOG.md file based on PR numbers.

methods.name: normalize_pr_changelog_entries
methods.description: Normalizes PR entries in the changelog by moving them into appropriate sections, creating sections if necessary.

methods.name: validate_changelog_entry_for_pr
methods.description: Validates that the changelog entries for a specific PR are correctly placed and referenced.

methods.name: validate_changelog_merge_hygiene
methods.description: Ensures that merge operations do not drop PR references in the changelog.
